blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems.
Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics.
We introduce World Models’ Last Exam in Physics , a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models.
The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension.
Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos.
Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements.
Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100.
Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions.
The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons.
By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.
blocks.zh:
视频世界模型可以产生视觉上令人信服但物理上不一致的序列,引起人们对它们对于所体现AI系统中的预测和规划的可靠性的关切.
现有的评价往往依赖于基于模型的判断或参考视频,而直接的物理测试则主要侧重于力学.
我们介绍了世界模型物理学最后考试,这是评价视频世界模型物理一致性的基于衡量的基准。
该基准包括40个可控制的任务,涉及机械、光学、流体、热和相变现象、电磁和地表张力。
每个任务将一个初始图像和一个带有预先定义的物理标准的一代即时对齐,使得可以对可观察到的物理关系进行可解释的测试而不需要参考视频.
其评价人员将任务可观测性筛选与针对任务的数量物理测量相结合.
对1 280个视频的8个视频生成模型的实验显示,各任务之间持续存在物理上的差异和巨大差异,最佳模型的总得分达到57.76分.
对已知物理关系的合成视频的评价为测量模块在受控条件下的有效性提供了证据.
在任务内部的排名和对等比较中,评价人员对人的判断也比直接的视觉语言模型基线更为一致。
该基准将物理域的覆盖范围与基于可计量证据的分数和明确的计量限制相结合,为诊断物理不一致情况并跟踪实现物理一致的视频世界模型的进展提供了可解释的基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Using video generation models as world models for prediction and planning requires them to reproduce how environments evolve under physical constraints. Despite substantial advances in visual quality, temporal coherence, and scene complexity ( Bar-Tal et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025c ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2025 ) , current models can still generate physically implausible motions and interactions ( Bansal et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2024 ; Rädsch et al., 2026 ) . As video models are increasingly explored as learned world simulators ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Bruce et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) and as foundations for world action models (WAMs) that couple future-state prediction with action generation ( Bi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) , such violations may undermine the reliability of simulated outcomes and the plans derived from them. Assessing their suitability for this role therefore requires systematic evaluation of whether generated events satisfy the relevant physical relationships. This evaluation should identify which phenomena models reproduce reliably, characterize where they fail, and determine whether new methods reduce these failures, providing a basis for measuring progress toward physically consistent video world models.
blocks.zh: 使用视频生成模型作为预测和规划的世界模型,要求它们复制环境如何在物理限制下演变. 尽管在视觉质量、时间一致性和场景复杂性方面取得了很大进步(Bar-Tal等,2024;Yang等,2025c;Polyak等,2024;Kong等,2024;Wan等,2025;Zheng等,2025b;Ma等,2026;Seedance等,2026;Team等,2025),但目前的模型仍然可以产生物理上不合理的运动和相互作用(Bansal等,2025;Meng等,2024;Rädsch等,2026)。 随着视频模型作为学习型世界模拟器(杨等,2023;布鲁斯等,2024;钱等,2026;赵等,2026a)以及作为将未来状态预测与行动生成相结合的世界行动模型(WAMS)的基础(Bi等,2026;Li等,2026b;Kim等,2026;Ye等,2026),此类侵权可能损害模拟结果的可靠性和由此产生的计划. 因此,要评估它们是否适合发挥这一作用,就必须系统地评估所产生的事件是否符合相关的物理关系。 这一评估应确定哪些现象模型可以可靠地复制,哪些现象模型不能复制,并确定新方法是否减少了这些失败,为衡量实现物理上一致的视频世界模型的进展提供了依据。

blocks.en:
Existing evaluations of physical consistency draw on vision-language model (VLM) judgments, reference-based comparisons, or direct tests of physical relationships. VLM-based methods cover diverse phenomena, but their judgments depend on the evaluator’s own physical reasoning ( Bansal et al., 2025 ; Meng et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . Current VLMs still have limited capabilities in understanding physical relationships and reasoning about dynamic interactions, which can compromise the reliability of their evaluations. For example, PQSG reports that GPT-5.5 achieves 64.6% accuracy on physics questions in FinePhyEval, compared with 88.4% on object-level questions, illustrating the difficulty of judging physical behavior ( Pothiraj et al., 2026 ) . Reference-based approaches assess generated videos through comparisons with reference observations. Physics-IQ covers multiple physical domains, but evaluates similarity to reference videos rather than directly testing physical laws, making its scores sensitive to reference quality and video alignment ( Rädsch et al., 2026 ) . Direct physical tests, including Principia, instead measure quantities such as object motion and assess whether they satisfy physical laws or the conditions specified in the prompt ( Thozhiyoor et al., 2026a ; Le et al., 2025 ; Khanbayov and Kurban, 2026 ; Thozhiyoor et al., 2026b ) . These tests mainly cover mechanics, while some measurement-based approaches also require real recordings, calibrated data, or simulator ground truth ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Jain and Wu, 2026 ) .
These gaps motivate a framework for testing observable physical relationships across domains, in which physical scores are derived from task-specific measurements without requiring reference videos or simulator ground truth, while a VLM provides preliminary consistency and observability screening.
blocks.zh:
对物理一致性的现有评价借鉴了视觉语言模型(VLM)判断,基于参考的比较,或对物理关系的直接测试. 基于VLM的方法涵盖了多种现象,但其判断取决于评估者自身的物理推理(Bansal等,2025;Meng等,2024;Lin等,2026a;Luo等,2026). 目前的VLM在理解物理关系和对动态相互作用的推理方面仍然能力有限,这可能会损害其评价的可靠性. 例如,PQSG报告说,GPT-5.5在FinePhyEval的物理问题上实现了64.6%的精确度,而在对象级别问题上则达到了88.4%,说明了判断物理行为的困难(Pothiraj等,2026年). 基于参考的方法通过比较参考观测结果,评估生成的视频。 Physics-IQ涵盖多个物理域,但评价与参考视频相似,而不是直接测试物理定律,使其分数对参考质量和视频对接敏感(Rädsch等,2026年). 直接的物理测试,包括Principia, 测量物体运动等数量,并评估这些测试是否符合物理定律,或及时性中规定的条件(Thozhiyoor等人,2026a; Le等,2025;Khanbayov和Kurban,2026;Thozhiyoor等,2026b.). 这些测试主要涵盖力学,而一些基于测量的方法也需要真实的录音,校正数据,或者模拟地真(Wang等,2026b;Jain和Wu,2026).
这些空白激发了一个不同领域间可观测物理关系的测试框架,其中物理分数取自特定任务的测量,而不需要参考视频或模拟地面真相,而VLM则提供初步的一致性和可观察性筛选.

blocks.en:
To address this challenge, we introduce World Models’ Last Exam in Physics , a measurement-based benchmark comprising 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface-tension effects.
Our central idea is to pair controlled generation conditions with measurable physical criteria.
As shown in Figure 1 , each task defines an image–prompt input, a target physical process, and observable relationships for evaluating the generated video.
Our evaluator assesses temporal consistency and task observability for each video. Independently of the screening outcome, it attempts to extract task-specific quantities, such as oscillation periods, reflection angles, and liquid levels, using tracking, segmentation, and temporal analysis. The recovered quantities are compared with predefined physical criteria. The screening outcome determines whether the physical score contributes to the composite score; passing the screen neither establishes physical correctness nor guarantees recovery of every required quantity. The resulting composite scores summarize model performance across the benchmark’s nine task categories.

blocks.en:
We evaluate eight video generation models across 40 tasks using 1,280 generated videos.
The best-performing model achieves an overall score of 57.76 out of 100, with substantial variation in performance across tasks and physical domains.
These results reveal persistent challenges in generating physically consistent videos and highlight the value of task-specific measurements for diagnosing model weaknesses.
Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce a measurement-based benchmark comprising 40 controlled video generation tasks covering mechanics, optics, fluid behavior, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface-tension effects. • We develop an interpretable evaluation protocol that combines temporal-consistency and task-observability screening with task-specific physical measurements, explicitly distinguishing physical test outcomes from cases with insufficient measurement evidence. • We conduct a systematic evaluation of eight video generation models across the benchmark’s 40 tasks, revealing a gap between temporal coherence and performance on explicit physical tests, as well as substantial variation across tasks and physical domains.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview and Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 2.1 概述和任务制定

blocks.en: Our benchmark assesses observable physical consistency in generated videos through controlled experiments and quantitative measurements. It tests whether quantities extracted from a video, such as positions and angles, satisfy the physical relationships specified by the task. Each assessment is restricted to these observable relationships under the stated experimental assumptions; unmeasured physical properties remain unverified.
blocks.zh: 我们的基准通过受控实验和定量测量,评估所生成视频中可观察到的物理一致性。 它检验从视频中取出的数量,如位置和角度,是否满足任务所指定的物理关系. 每一次评估都局限于上述实验假设下的这些可观察到的关系;未经测量的物理特性仍未核实。

blocks.en: Overview. As shown in Figure 1 , the benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks organized into nine task categories, evaluated through a standardized generation and measurement workflow. For each task, an initial frame is generated using GPT-Image-2.5 and paired with a prompt specifying how the experiment should proceed. The video model then generates a sequence conditioned on these inputs. Our evaluator first checks each generated video for temporal consistency and semantic coherence, assessing whether the required objects, events, and regions remain identifiable and measurable. Task-specific physical quantities are extracted using tools including CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) for point tracking, SAM 2 ( Ravi et al., 2025 ) for segmentation, and dedicated routines for geometric fitting, region-of-interest photometry, and temporal analysis. The extracted measurements are compared with the predefined physical criteria without requiring reference videos. The screening outcome determines whether the physical score contributes to the composite score, while independent measurement results and evidence availability are retained for diagnostic analysis. Composite scores are aggregated across tasks to compare model performance.

blocks.en: 2.2 Physics-Grounded Task Design
blocks.zh: 2.2 物理组合任务设计

blocks.en: Table 1 : The nine task categories, representative phenomena, and governing physical principles.
blocks.zh: 表1:九个任务类别、代表性现象和物理原则。

blocks.en: We construct 40 tasks organized into nine categories, covering a broad range of common physical phenomena encountered in everyday life. Table 1 summarizes representative phenomena and their governing physical principles. Our central design principle is to formulate physical predictions as observable relationships that can be tested without absolute spatial or temporal calibration. We organize these tests into three types: spatial relationships among geometric quantities, temporal relationships among periods, durations, or event timings, and coupled spatiotemporal relationships between motion and geometry. For each task, we identify the governing law and its assumptions, derive the relationship to be tested, and design a scene that makes the required observables measurable within a single video. Where appropriate, matched comparative setups allow shared unknown factors to cancel from the tested relationship.
blocks.zh: 我们把40个任务分为9个类别,涵盖日常生活中遇到的各种共同的物理现象。 表1概述了代表性现象及其物理指导原则。 我们的中心设计原则是制定物理预测,作为可观测的关系,在不绝对空间或时间校正的情况下可以测试. 我们把这些测试组织成三种类型:几何数量之间的空间关系,时期、持续时间或事件时间之间的时间关系,以及运动和几何之间的伴生空间关系。 就每项任务而言,我们确定指导性法律及其假设,得出有待测试的关系,并设计一个场景,使所需的可观测性能在单一视频中可测量. 在适当情况下,匹配的比较设置允许共享未知因素从被测试的关系中取消.

blocks.en: Spatial relationships. Spatial tests check whether geometric quantities extracted from a physical process satisfy its predicted relationships. A classical example is projectile motion. Under uniform gravity and negligible air resistance, a projectile launched at 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} and returning to its launch height should have a maximum height H H and horizontal range R R satisfying H / R = 1 / 4 H/R=1/4 . Here, H H is measured relative to the launch height, and R R is the horizontal distance between launch and landing. In the oblique-projectile task, we evaluate r spatial = | H R − 1 4 | . r_{\mathrm{spatial}}=\left|\frac{H}{R}-\frac{1}{4}\right|. (2) A residual near zero indicates agreement with the predicted trajectory geometry. The initial speed and gravitational acceleration cancel from this ratio, allowing the relationship to be tested without estimating either quantity. A common spatial scale also allows H H and R R to be measured directly in pixels without absolute length calibration. However, the ratio does not remove arbitrary perspective distortion. We therefore specify an appropriate side-view geometry in both the image-generation and video-generation prompts.

blocks.en: Temporal tests examine whether measured periods, durations, or event timings satisfy the expected physical relationship. For example, two small-angle pendulums with equal lengths under the same gravity should have approximately equal periods, even when their bob masses differ. We measure their periods T 1 T_{1} and T 2 T_{2} in frames and evaluate r temporal = | T 1 T 2 − 1 | . r_{\mathrm{temporal}}=\left|\frac{T_{1}}{T_{2}}-1\right|. (3) This test checks whether changing the bob mass preserves the oscillation period. blocks.en: Reliable quantitative evaluation requires clearly defined experimental conditions and observable quantities for measurement. Ambiguous initial geometry, occlusion, or an incomplete observation interval can make a physical test inconclusive and confound model errors with limitations of the input setup. We therefore construct task-specific first frames and video prompts through an iterative process, as illustrated in Figure 1 , to establish the prescribed initial configuration and make the target process observable.
blocks.zh: 可靠的定量评价需要明确界定的实验条件和可观察的计量数量。 模糊的初始几何,隐蔽,或不完整的观测间隔,可以使物理测试无定论,并混淆模型错误与输入设置的限制. 因此,如图1所示,我们通过一个迭接进程构建针对特定任务的第一帧和视频提示,以建立规定的初始配置,使目标进程可以观察。

blocks.en: For each task, we translate the experimental requirements into an image prompt and use GPT-Image-2.5 to generate candidate first frames that establish the initial configuration and expose the quantities needed for measurement. Each first frame is paired with a video prompt specifying how the experiment begins and unfolds, which scene properties remain fixed, and the observation interval required for evaluation. For example, pendulum experiments require fixed pivots and sufficient oscillations to estimate periods, while melting experiments require visible initial and final liquid levels. We iteratively refine both prompts through pilot generation and human inspection: ambiguous configurations or poorly visible objects lead to image-prompt revisions and regenerated first frames, while unclear actions or insufficient observation intervals lead to video-prompt revisions. Revised pairs are tested again, forming a feedback loop between input construction and pilot inspection. Errors in extracting clearly visible evidence are addressed separately through evaluator review. The finalized image–prompt pairs are then submitted to eight video models through a common generation interface. The evaluation covers 40 tasks across nine categories, yielding 1,280 videos with four samples per task–model pair.

For videos with C ⁡ ( V ) < 80 C(V)<80 , the physical score P P does not contribute to the composite score S S , while independently obtained measurements and physical scores are retained. Passing the screen neither establishes physical correctness nor guarantees recovery of every required quantity.

blocks.en: Results by Task. Table 2 shows substantial variation in composite scores across models and tasks under the strict per-video consistency gate ( C ≥ 80 C\geq 80 ). Even the strongest model, Seedance, achieves an average composite score of approximately 57.76, indicating considerable room for improvement in generating videos that both satisfy the intended task and reproduce its physical behavior. Four tasks illustrate this variation. Melting ice containing a stone (P26) remains challenging for every evaluated model, with a model-averaged composite score of 3.45 and a maximum of 15.00. All eight models receive zero physical scores under the evaluation protocol, so their nonzero composite scores arise entirely from the consistency term. Light reflection (P18) reveals pronounced differences between models: Seedance and VBVR achieve scores of 96.15 and 95.75, respectively, whereas all other models score at most 49.82. Figure 2 (left) illustrates corresponding differences in the generated sequences, including clearly visible reflected rays in the Seedance and VBVR examples and missing reflections in several other outputs. Charged-sphere equilibrium (P31) exhibits a similarly large performance gap: Seedance and MiniMax score 98.34 and 97.24, respectively, whereas all other models score at most 15.00. As illustrated in Figure 2 (right), these two models generate outward-separated sphere configurations, while some other models show little separation or introduce additional spheres. Communicating-vessel equilibrium (P21), however, provides an example of consistently strong performance. All eight models score between 93.09 and 99.01 and pass the automatic consistency gate on every available video, indicating broad success on this particular equilibrium task.
blocks.zh: 按任务分列的结果。 表2显示在严格的每部录像一致性门(C 80 C\geq 80)下,各种模型和任务的综合分数有很大差异。 即使是最强的模型"种子"也取得了约57.76的平均综合得分,表明在生成既能满足预定任务又能复制其身体行为的视频方面还有相当大的改进余地. 有四项任务说明了这种差异。 含有一块石头(P26)的融冰对每一个被评价的模型来说仍然是挑战性的,模型平均综合得分为3.45分,最高得分为15.00分. 所有8个模型都根据评价协议获得0个物理分数,因此其非零综合分数完全出自一致性术语. 光反射(P18)揭示出模型之间的显著差异: 种子和VBVR的分数分别为96.15分和95.75分,而所有其他模型的分数最多为49.82分. 图2(左)显示生成序列的相应差异,包括种子和VBVR实例中清晰可见的反射线和其他几种输出中缺失的反射. 充电平面平衡(P31)表现出类似的巨大性能差距:种子和MiniMax的分数分别为98.34分和97.24分,而所有其他模型的分数最多为15.00分. 如图2(右)所示,这两个模型产生出外相分离的球面配置,而其他一些模型则显示很少分离或引入了额外的球面. 然而,交流-流体平衡(P21)提供了一个一贯表现强劲的例子。 所有8个型号在93.09至99.01之间得分,并在每个可用视频上通过自动一致性门,表明这一特殊均衡任务取得了广泛成功.

blocks.en: Results by Difficulty Level. The empirical difficulty groups, defined by mean composite scores across the evaluated models, summarize differences in observed task performance. Easy tasks include communicating-vessel equilibrium (P21), floating-ice immersion (P22), and hanging-chain equilibrium (P7). These examples involve relationships that can be evaluated from relatively stable configurations, which may partly explain their stronger performance. Medium tasks include free fall (P2) and pure rolling (P8), where reproducing recognizable motion is insufficient: the generated trajectories must also satisfy quantitative constraints on fall dynamics or the coupling between translation and rotation. For example, all available free-fall videos pass the automatic consistency gate ( C ≥ 80 C\geq 80 ), but the average composite score across models is only 26.61, showing that passing this gate does not guarantee a high physical score. Hard tasks include equal-mass collisions (P5), rough-incline round trips (P11), and melting ice containing a stone (P26). These scenarios require maintaining physical relationships through interactions or successive events, such as contact, motion reversal, and changes in object configuration. Their low scores may reflect difficulties coordinating these processes over time. Failures at the consistency stage also contribute: only 56.9% of available Hard videos pass the automatic consistency gate, compared with 89.4% of Easy videos. Thus, low composite scores can reflect both failures to realize the required task conditions and low physical scores under the measurement protocol. Model strengths also differ across these groups: MiniMax leads on Easy tasks, whereas Seedance achieves the highest task-averaged Hard score of 37.76, substantially above MiniMax’s 19.87, although its absolute score remains low.
blocks.zh: 困难程度的结果。 经验性困难组以平均综合得分的定义,概括了所观察到的任务业绩的差异。 容易的任务包括交流-活塞平衡(P21),活塞-冰浸润(P22)和悬挂链平衡(P7)等. 这些例子涉及可以从相对稳定的配置来评价的关系,这可以部分地解释其较强的性能. 中度任务包括自由倒地(P2)和纯滚动(P8),其中再生可识别运动不足:所生成的轨迹还须满足对倒地动力学的定量限制或翻译与旋转相接. 例如,所有可用的自由落地视频都通过自动一致性门(C ≥ 80 C\geq 80),但跨模型的平均综合分数只有26.61分,表明通过这个门并不能保证物理分数高. 困难的任务包括等量相撞(P5),粗线回行(P11)和含一石的融冰(P26). 这些情景需要通过互动或相接事件来维持物理关系,例如接触,运动倒转,以及对象配置的变化等. 它们的分数低,可能反映一段时间内协调这些进程的困难。 一致性阶段的失败也有所助益:只有56.9%的"硬"视频通过自动一致性门,而"Easy"视频为89.4%. 因此,低综合分数既能反映未能实现所需任务条件,又能反映测量协议下的低物理分数. 这些团体的模型优势也有所不同:MiniMax领先于Easy任务,而种子则实现了最高的任务平均硬分37.76分,大大高于MiniMax的19.87分,尽管其绝对分仍然很低.

blocks.en: Evaluator Validation on Synthetic Reference Videos. We assess whether the evaluator assigns appropriately high physical scores to synthetic reference videos designed to satisfy prescribed physical relationships. These videos are generated as 2D animations using existing tools: object states are computed from the specified relations and rendered frame by frame, while appearance variants preserve the underlying trajectories. We evaluate 480 reference videos across 40 tasks, with 12 videos per task. To isolate the physical measurement module, we bypass the VLM consistency gate. As shown by the light-gray bars in Figure 3 , the reference videos receive mean physical scores of 97.93, 96.64, and 98.25 on Easy, Medium, and Hard tasks, respectively, with an overall mean of 97.53 out of 100. These results support the evaluator’s agreement with the prescribed physical relationships under controlled synthetic conditions.

Frames are resized to a maximum side length of 640 pixels, and inference uses a temperature of zero. Both methods are evaluated using human annotations for 320 videos across 40 tasks. blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Physics-aware video generation incorporates physical structure through simulation, reasoning, representation learning, and post-training.
Simulation-based approaches combine rigid-body, deformable-body, or continuum dynamics with diffusion-based synthesis ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Montanaro et al., 2024 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) .
PhysCtrl ( Wang et al., 2025a ) guides video synthesis with generated 3D trajectories, while PhysDreamer ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) transfers video dynamics priors to interactive 3D objects.
Reasoning-guided methods incorporate physical context through prompt refinement and explicit planning ( Xue et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025b ) .
At the representation level, WISA ( Wang et al., 2025b ) encodes physical descriptions and properties, while VideoREPA ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) aligns spatiotemporal token relations with video foundation models.
Recent approaches further incorporate retrieved examples, joint RGB-perception modeling, and latent physical dynamics ( Cheng et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026b ; Shen et al., 2026 ) .
Post-training methods explore AI feedback, task-specific rewards, and learned physical representations to improve generated dynamics ( Furuta et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
NewtonRewards ( Le et al., 2025 ) constructs physics rewards from measurable proxies, while PhyGDPO and PhyWorld optimize generation using physics-aware preferences ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) .
These advances motivate task-specific tests that determine which physical relationships generated videos preserve under stated assumptions.
Our benchmark provides such tests through controlled experimental conditions and explicit quantitative measurements.

PhysCtrl(Wang等,2025a)以生成的3D轨迹来引导视频合成,而PhysDreamer(Zhang等,2024)则将视频动态前传至交互式3D对象.

这些进步激发了针对具体任务的测试,以确定哪些物理关系生成的视频是在所陈述的假设下保存的.
我们的基准通过受控制的实验条件和明确的定量测量提供这种测试。

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks use four complementary forms of evidence: general quality metrics, evaluator judgments, reference observations, and direct physical measurements.
General quality benchmarks assess visual fidelity, temporal coherence, and compositional alignment ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Sun et al., 2025 ) , but these criteria alone do not establish physical correctness.
Judgment-based benchmarks assess physics and commonsense through human annotations, VLMs, or learned evaluators ( Zheng et al., 2025a ; Bansal et al., 2025 ; Bansal et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) , with finer-grained criteria and structured questions improving interpretability ( Lin et al., 2026a ; Pothiraj et al., 2026 ) .
However, their scores reflect evaluator judgments rather than directly measured deviations in physical quantities.
Reference-based approaches, including Physics-IQ, Physics-IQ Verified, and RigidBench, compare generations with real or simulated observations ( Motamed et al., 2025 ; Rädsch et al., 2026 ; Jain and Wu, 2026 ) .
They require suitable reference data, and reference similarity alone does not isolate violations of specific physical laws.
Measurement-based approaches provide more explicit diagnostics: PhysWeep estimates physical parameters ( Khanbayov and Kurban, 2026 ) , Principia tests paired-object relationships ( Thozhiyoor et al., 2026b ) , and GAUGE combines measured trajectories with calibrated physical metadata ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
Their video evaluations primarily target selected mechanical dynamics, leaving room for quantitative tests of other physical phenomena.
We complement these approaches with controlled experiments spanning mechanics, optics, and other physical domains.
It quantifies deviations from task-specific spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal relationships under stated assumptions, using scale-canceling comparisons where applicable and computing physical scores from measurements without VLM judgments of physical correctness.

现有基准采用四种补充形式的证据:一般质量衡量标准、评估判断、参考观测和直接物理测量。
一般质量基准评估视觉忠诚度、时间一致性和组成一致性(Huang等人,2024年;Liu等人,2001年)。 2024b; Sun等, 2025),但仅这些标准并不能确定物理正确性.
基于判断的基准通过人类说明、VLMs或有学问的评价员来评估物理学和常识(郑等,2025a;Bansal等,2025;Bansal等,2026;Meng等,2024;Gu等,2025;Gu等,2026;Li等,2026a),具有更细的加分标准和结构化问题,改善可解释性(Lin等,2026a;Pothiraj等,2026)。
然而,它们的分数反映了评价者的判断,而不是直接衡量实际数量上的偏差。
基于参考的方法,包括物理-IQ、物理-IQ验证和Rigid Bench, 将几代人与真实或模拟观测进行比较(Motamed等人,2025年;Rädsch等人,2026年;Jain和Wu,2026年)。
它们需要适当的参考数据,仅参考相似性并不能孤立违反具体物理法的行为。
基于衡量的方法提供了更明确的诊断: PhysWeep估计物理参数(Khanbayov和Kurban,2026年),Principia测试对等-对象关系(Thozhiyoor等,2026b),GAUGE将所测量的轨迹与被校正的物理元数据(Wang等,2026b.
他们的视频评价主要针对选定的机械动力学,为对其他物理现象进行定量测试留有余地.
我们用跨越力学、光学和其他物理领域的受控实验来补充这些方法。
它在说明的假设下量化了对特定任务空间、时间和时空关系的偏差,在适用的情况下使用比分递减比较,并计算了没有VLM物理正确性判断的测量结果的物理分数。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced World Models’ Last Exam in Physics , a benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video generation through 40 controlled tasks and explicit, task-specific measurements. Our evaluation framework separates temporal consistency and task observability from physical correctness, grounding scores in measurable relationships and retaining evidence for interpreting failures. Experiments across eight video generation models reveal persistent difficulties in reproducing quantitative physical relationships and completing the required physical events. Evaluation on synthetic reference videos supports the measurement module under controlled conditions, while human evaluation shows higher confirmed agreement than direct VLM scoring in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. These findings highlight the value of explicit physical measurements for assessing generated videos. Current evaluation remains constrained by the visibility and reliable extraction of task-relevant evidence. Future work will extend task coverage and improve measurement robustness in more complex scenes. We hope this benchmark provides a useful foundation for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and developing video generation models that more reliably reproduce physical phenomena.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了《世界物理学模型》的最后考试,这是通过40项可控任务和明确、具体任务的测量来评估视频生成中物理一致性的基准。 我们的评价框架将时间一致性和任务可观察性与物理正确性区分开来,将分数建立在可衡量关系中,并保留解释失败的证据。 跨出8个视频生成模型的实验显示,在复制定量物理关系和完成所需的物理事件方面持续存在困难. 对合成参考视频的评价支持在受控条件下的测量模块,而人类评价显示,在任务内排名和对等比较中,与直接VLM评分相比,确认的一致度更高. 这些调查结果突出了明确物理测量对评估生成的视频的价值。 目前的评价仍然受到与任务相关的证据的能见度和可靠取出的限制。 今后的工作将扩大任务范围,并改进更为复杂的场景中的计量稳健性。 我们希望这一基准为诊断物理不一致和开发更可靠地复制物理现象的视频生成模型提供有益的基础.

Tables 4 and 5 report the consistency score ( C C ), physical score ( P P ), and combined score ( S S ) for all 40 tasks and eight video generation models.
The consistency score assesses temporal consistency and task observability, while the physical score summarizes task-specific measurements.
Physical evaluation is performed independently for all available videos, regardless of whether they pass the consistency gate.
The reported P P therefore includes videos with C < 80 C<80 and is not set to zero solely because the gate rejects a video.
For each video, we compute S = 0.15 C + 0.85 P 1 [ C ≥ 80 ] S=0.15C+0.85P\,\mathbf{1}[C\geq 80] . The gate affects only the contribution of P P to S S ; the original C C and independently evaluated P P are retained.
All scores are expressed on a 0–100 scale and averaged over available seeds within each model–task pair, with the gate applied before averaging.
